categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in manufacturing, processing, and trading of molds, various mechanical and appearance parts, and surface treatment of alloy products. Its main products include metal casings and internal components for portable and 3C information communication products, as well as medical device components, semiconductor equipment parts, and aerospace precision metal parts. The company also provides CDMO services for medical device assembly and sterilization.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced materials science and manufacturing technologies including magnesium, aluminum, zinc, stainless steel, carbon fiber, and composite materials. Production methods include die casting, extrusion, forging, stamping, plastic injection molding, metal injection molding (MIM), CNC machining, laser engraving, anodizing, PVD coating, and other surface treatments. It emphasizes integrated in-house processes, automation, and innovative multi-material and multi-process manufacturing techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international leading brands in the portable computing, consumer electronics (3C), medical devices, semiconductor equipment, and aerospace industries. The company serves OEMs and ODMs requiring high-precision, high-quality metal and composite structural components. Major end markets include global PC and AI PC manufacturers, medical device companies, semiconductor equipment makers, and aerospace component suppliers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China (notably its Suqian plant), with plans to expand manufacturing to Thailand. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with over 97% of revenue from Asian markets and minor sales in the Americas. Taiwan serves as the headquarters and major production base, while overseas facilities support global supply chain flexibility.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on precision manufacturing of metal and composite structural components. It sources raw materials such as magnesium, aluminum, zinc, and stainless steel from upstream suppliers and delivers finished parts to downstream OEMs and assembly plants. It maintains vertical integration of mold design, tooling, forming, machining, and surface treatment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include diversification into non-consumer electronics sectors such as medical devices, semiconductor equipment, and aerospace. The company invests heavily in R&D for advanced materials, multi-material integration, surface treatments, and smart manufacturing automation. It pursues high-value, differentiated products with high precision and volume production capabilities, while advancing sustainability initiatives like carbon footprint management and renewable energy adoption.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal and composite casings, internal components, and related services such as medical device assembly (CDMO). The company also earns income from investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures. Sales are largely contract-based with major OEM customers, denominated mainly in US dollars.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Taiwanese listed companies such as Huafu Technology, Hongzhun Precision, Lika Precision, Luxshare Precision, Juteng International, and BYD Electronics. The company positions itself as a global leader with comprehensive manufacturing capabilities, strong R&D, and high automation, serving high-end 3C, medical, semiconductor, and aerospace markets. It differentiates through vertical integration, product diversity, and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$18.08 billion, a slight year-on-year increase of 0.1%. Net profit attributable to owners rose significantly by 44.2% to NT$13.2 billion, with earnings per share of NT$19.40. The company maintains a strong financial position with steady asset base and equity growth, investing over 5% of revenue in R&D. It demonstrates resilience amid global economic uncertainties and supply chain shifts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers customers high-precision, high-quality, and highly customized metal and composite structural components with advanced surface treatments and integrated manufacturing processes. Its competitive advantages include a strong R&D team, comprehensive in-house production capabilities, leading automation, and ability to rapidly respond to design changes. It emphasizes sustainability, cost efficiency, and long-term partnerships with global OEMs, enabling it to meet complex and evolving product requirements.
